messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin works by calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system.
Gabapentin does this by binding to the alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels in nerve cells.
This subunit is thought to normalize chemical signals nerves send to each other.
This results in a calmer, less excitable nerve circuit.
That same effect helps in different ways depending on what gabapentin is treating:
Epilepsy - dampens the runaway electrical firing that causes seizures.
Postherpetic neuralgia (shingles nerve pain) - reduces the abnormal pain signals from nerves damaged by shingles.
Restless legs syndrome (gabapentin enacarbil / Horizant) has an exact mechanism that is less clear.
The same calming effect on overactive nerves is thought to ease the urge-to-move sensation.
Gabapentin is not an opioid, sedative, or anti-inflammatory painkiller.
Gabapentin works directly on the nerves.
Gabapentin helps nerve-related pain.
Gabapentin isn't useful for everyday pain like headaches or sprains.
Most people need 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for the full effect to build up.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin enacarbil", "has effect", "eases the urge-to-move sensation"]

The relation 'has effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or condition produces the specific effect described by the object entity when applied or present.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'acts in': The subject drug exerts its effects within the anatomical or physiological system specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
